issues.message: Feature F008 has low priority but is critical for HIPAA compliance - consider elevating priority
Forgot password functionality mentioned in Login Screen but not defined as a formal feature
Notification system relies on external email service - ensure SLA agreements are in place

recommendations: Consider adding two-factor authentication for enhanced security
Implement rate limiting on login attempts to prevent brute force attacks
Add feature for patients to rate and review doctors after appointments
Consider implementing video consultation capability for future enhancement
Add SMS notification option in addition to email
Implement waiting list functionality for fully booked doctors
Consider adding insurance information to patient profiles
Add ability for patients to upload medical documents
Implement recurring appointment scheduling for chronic care patients
Add multi-language support for diverse patient populations
Consider implementing a mobile app in addition to web interface
Add analytics dashboard for doctors to track their appointment patterns
